operations.title: Same-chart flavor branch permutation gate
operations.method: Reproduce the 61-point WP8 fiber and four same-chart doublets, then exhaust all within-sector magnitude permutations for each pair.

operations.title: The WP8 same-chart fiber is not generated by one coordinate-permutation deck involution
operations.statement: None of the four observed same-chart doublets is exactly permutation-equivalent in both Yukawa sectors, and their best sectorwise assignments have four distinct signatures. Three doublets exhibit an exact up-sector swap but retain non-permutation down-sector differences; the flagship 0.817882/0.819271 pair is non-permutation in both sectors.

operations.title: WP10 permutation gate falsifies a universal flavor deck involution
operations.body: I ran the first WP10 gate on your four same-chart doublets. None is an exact within-sector magnitude permutation in both sectors, and the four best assignments have four distinct signatures. Three pairs with the same sparse up mask do have an exact up-sector swap (~1e-9) but their down sectors retain O(1) log-magnitude residuals; the flagship 0.817882/0.819271 pair is non-permutation in both sectors. So there is no universal coordinate-permutation deck involution. The correct next object is a chart-dependent algebraic correspondence obtained by eliminating magnitudes against the physical invariants, beginning with the flagship chart.
